system.description:
Found in every terrain and environment, their curiosity and ambition drive them to explore

every corner of the world, making them a ubiquitous and versatile race.

Tenacious

+1 to all skills and initiative [A]

Human Adaptations: Adaptable — In addition to your Tenacious trait, you also gain a Minor Boon.

Adaptations

You gain a Minor Boon of your choice — pick one from the Nimble Boons compendium and drag it onto your character. [M]

Nim+ Volume I ancestry variant (LewisH, Santuric). Variants replace the base ancestry: pick this instead of the standard version. Note: variants make your hero stronger than normal.
